info.title: HoH Local Control API
info.description: Design contract. The server is not implemented in this bootstrap pack. Local-only: the host binds 127.0.0.1, rejects requests whose Host or Origin is not the bound loopback address (DNS-rebinding/CSRF guard), and requires a per-host random token. This is request integrity for a single-user VM, not a multi-tenant permission system.

post.summary: 持久接收命令；202不是任务完成

requestBody.description: CR-028: SendInput JSON request at most 8388608 raw bytes; decoded normalized UTF-8 body at most 1048576 bytes. Non-SendInput remains at most 2097152 raw bytes, checked after decoding the command kind but before any write; padding counts. Excess/broken body remains 400 BAD_REQUEST, never 202/413. Adapter inline/file encoding is specified in CR-028 §4; this does not change the M3 input state machine.

202.description: Durably accepted (not task completion). A replay with the same idempotency_key and the same payload hash returns the original 202 body byte for byte and sets Idempotent-Replayed: true; the same key with a different payload is 409 KEY_REUSE (CR-003).

run_id.description: Run the command applies to; for StartRun the run created in the same transaction.

422.description: Invalid specification content or shape is SPEC_INVALID (not retryable); the existing index failure diagnostic is retained (CR-036).

503.description: Service unavailable. SPEC_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE means Git enumeration or filesystem reads needed to index the specification failed; retryable=true, current_revision is preserved, and no command, CR, revision or spec.index_failed is written. Uses the same Error body and no Retry-After header as DB_BUSY (CR-036). CR-028: object preflight for SendInput may return STORAGE_LOW_SPACE, retryable=false, details={reason:STORAGE_LOW_SPACE,available_bytes,required_bytes,min_free_bytes}, required_bytes=object_write_bytes+min_free_bytes. No command/input/public-message acceptance is written; client preserves draft/target and reports not accepted (CLI exit 69), retries only on explicit user action. If already accepted (202), delivery-space failure keeps the same input QUEUED and records the diagnostic through the existing delivery chain. Low-space preflight alone does not block Pause/Cancel (202 if the state transaction commits); real ENOSPC/EDQUOT of that transaction is DB_FULL/503 with no 202.

get.description: SSE: replay (after, H] then live > H where H is the high-watermark taken at connect. after and Last-Event-ID must agree (409 otherwise).

get.description: CR-028: all filters intersect. after_seq is exclusive, before_seq is exclusive, watermark inclusive. Cursor binds filters/H/generation; tampering or cross-Run iteration/attempt is rejected. Null project events never appear under a Run. I/A membership follows the closed producer classification and H-dependent iteration rules; absent identity is not guessed.

get.summary: Input history reconstructed at a fixed committed watermark

parameters.name: watermark
parameters.description: H from InputStatePageRef; if omitted on the first page, choose the committed watermark. Continuation retains the same H.

200.description: Existing Page shape. Items are input facts at H with input_id, state, actual role/role_epoch/boundary and rejection reason, each retaining public source references; absent facts are null/unknown. Order by acceptance seq ascending, then input_id ascending. Empty items and null next_cursor mean no more history.

404.description: Run pagination convention: BAD_REQUEST for invalid/tampered/cross-query cursor or watermark beyond committed H; RUN_NOT_FOUND for missing Run.

410.description: Index generation expired; resnapshot using top-level snapshot_watermark.

get.description: CR-028 C3, delivered by M4-T03: additive extension of the existing read model, consumed by M4-T02. Limit defaults to 100 and is 1–500; cursor binds Run/query/H/generation. Repeated cursor yields the same page. Input transitions committed after H never change an old page; SSE/new snapshots deliver them. No input writes, resubmission or state-machine change; existing routes and error meanings remain unchanged. AC-064-01: after rebuilding the index at the same H, fresh cursors reconstruct identical items; old-generation cursors return 410 CURSOR_EXPIRED with top-level snapshot_watermark. Cursor binding includes run_id/query (including limit), H and generation; changed query/H/limit or tampering returns 404 BAD_REQUEST. Empty history returns items=[], next_cursor=null and watermark=H; the final nonempty page also has next_cursor=null.

Forbidden.description: Missing/invalid token, or Host/Origin not the bound loopback address

localToken.name: X-HoH-Token
localToken.description: Random 256-bit token generated at host start, stored in .hoh/host.json (mode 0600). `hoh web` opens the browser with the token in the URL fragment; the page keeps it in memory. SSE uses the same header via fetch-based EventSource.

details.description: Machine-readable context, e.g. key_path, cycle, required/available (CR-003).

watermark.description: event seq the page is consistent with

BlockRef.description: Typed source identity; absent historical facts are null, never inferred from an Agent name. Trace labels come from the M3 trace export; UI precedence does not rewrite it.

block_id.description: event:<project_id>:<seq>:<part> or entity:<type>:<id>; historical entities also bind spec/candidate/attempt. A streamed public message keeps one id.

BlockDescriptor.description: CR-028 §1/2 and REQ-013: public summaries only, bodies on demand via registered artifacts. Event seq is project ordered. Identity is resolved at H; no raw transcript, secrets, hidden reasoning or internal Prompt.

TimelinePage.description: CR-028: fixed H and index generation; cursor binds every filter, seek position and H. Strict seq order, at most requested limit, at most 256 KiB body per page. Complete generation switch expires old page cursors; ordinary restart does not. Query while rebuilding is 503 DB_BUSY/details.reason=index_rebuilding. Truth is not deleted to expire cursors.

CursorExpiredError.description: CR-028: query-page expiry uses the unchanged SSE 410 shape: code/message/top-level snapshot_watermark. Complete generation switches can expire page cursors; SSE expiry remains unreachable under v1 event retention.

UiBaseline.description: ADR-031 project baseline: latest ACCEPTED candidate from a COMPLETED project Run, otherwise null. Never replaced by the current Run discovery baseline.

UiTask.description: CR-028 C3 / M4A-002: at snapshot H, consider this Run's RUNNING tasks. The ordering timestamp is attempts.started_at of that Task's unique current RUNNING Attempt at H: the persisted start fact recorded when the runner accepts dispatch and moves it to STARTING. A retry uses the new Attempt, never a finished historical Attempt, Task creation time, first-ever start or client time. Compare parsed UTC instants descending, then task_id ascending. Missing/unparseable started_at or no unique RUNNING Attempt yields unknown ordering time plus a diagnostic; unknowns sort after known times and among themselves by task_id ascending. With no RUNNING Task, ui.task is null. All other tasks remain queryable through the existing tasks route. Reconstruct facts at H, never substitute later mutable state.

watermark.description: H from the same getRun snapshot. All pages reconstruct committed input state at this H, never the mutable current row at a later watermark.

cursor.description: Null for the first page; otherwise Page.next_cursor. Opaque continuation binds run_id/query, H and index generation. Omit the query parameter when null.

InputStatePageRef.description: CR-028 C3: exact read-only reference {run_id,watermark,limit,cursor} to GET /v1/runs/{run_id}/inputs. Reuse the existing H/limit/cursor read model additively. Fetch Page {items,next_cursor,watermark}; continue with the same run_id/H/limit and next_cursor until null. No embedded full history or new command/delivery loop.

run_baseline.description: M3 run.baseline plus recorded baseline-test facts (ADR-039); preserves source shape, unknowns and baseline_complete. Read-only discovery, distinct from project baseline.

last_activity.description: Explicit committed public activity/usage with role/epoch/attempt/session and observed time. Alive alone means activity unknown; model summary is labelled analysis.

input_states.description: References to persisted QUEUED/DELIVERED/APPLIED/REJECTED input history at the same getRun H; actual role/epoch/boundary and refusal sources come from committed facts. Empty history returns an empty Page, never fabricated states; 202 is acceptance only.

UiProjection.description: CR-028: all UI facts come from the same getRun transaction at H. No prior snapshot fragments or future bindings are mixed into it. Missing facts are null.

ProgressProjection.description: CR-028 §3: denominator is all requirements of the approved spec; numerator only all-AC PASS requirements of this Run's current ACCEPTED candidate. DEGRADED is separate and stays in denominator. New candidate/spec resets accepted; missing spec is 0/0, never complete. Issues use authoritative OPEN/REOPENED functions. Existing projection.acceptance retains AC counts.

projection.description: Existing projection fields remain additive, including trace, regression, readiness, open_questions, team and AC-level acceptance; CR-028 adds ui/progress without replacing M3 shapes.

context.description: Valid UTF-8, clipped at grapheme boundaries, at most 256 encoded bytes.

ArtifactSearchPage.description: CR-028: increasing byte offsets, literal UTF-8 matches including overlaps. Cursor binds sha256/query/next unreported start/scanned offset. At most 8 MiB newly scanned per call, carrying at most query_bytes-1 tail bytes; limit resumes at last reported start+1, never skips remaining matches. No match is an empty page; continue until next_cursor is null.
